title: 猫的胡须有什么用
subtitle: 量一量这个洞钻不钻得过去
character: wearing a mustard yellow t-shirt, grey shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, coloured pencil drawing with visible strokes and layered hatching on textured paper, warm grey, mustard yellow and soft orange

pages.zh:
邻居家的猫
蹲在台阶上晒太阳。
它嘴边那几根白毛
直直地翘着，
比我的手指还长。
pages.scene: Waist-up view of the little boy crouching on a doorstep beside one cat, his face large in the frame and turned towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, smiling a little; the cat sits close to him with its long whiskers spread wide. No other person in the picture.

pages.zh:
胡须不只长在嘴边。
眼睛上面有几根，
下巴上也有，
两条前腿的后面
还各藏着几根。

别的毛只是浅浅地
插在皮上。
胡须扎得很深，
根上连着神经，
一动就有信号传进去。

它能感觉到
很轻很轻的一股风。
墙就在前面，
风绕过来一点点，
它立刻就知道了。
pages.scene: One single cat sitting close beside a wall on a cream background, its whiskers spread wide, thin lines of moving air drifting around the edge of the wall towards its face. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
最要紧的是宽度。
胡须向左右张开，
正好等于它身上
最宽的那一处，
不多也不少。

所以钻洞以前，
它先把脸探进去。
胡须碰不到边，
身子就过得去；
碰到了，就退回来。

这个洞看着太窄了。
胡须两边都蹭到，
它立刻停下来，
掉头走开了，
另找一条路进去。
pages.scene: One single cat with its head pushed into a narrow gap between two stacked wooden crates on a cream background, its whiskers pressed against both sides of the gap, its body pulling back. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
夜里屋子全黑，
它照样走得稳。
桌子腿在哪儿，
椅子在哪儿，
胡须一路替它探。
pages.scene: One single cat walking between table legs and chair legs in a dark unlit room on a cream background, its whiskers brushing past the wood. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
所以胡须剪不得。
要是剪短一截，
它就量不准了，
走路会撞上东西，
跳也跳不稳。

胡须还会说话。
舒服的时候，
它软软地垂向两边；
一紧张起来，
就全部朝前张开。
pages.scene: Two cats drawn side by side on a cream background: the left one relaxed with its whiskers lying softly out to the sides, the right one tense with its whiskers pushed forward in a wide fan. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
胡须也会掉。
偶尔掉下一根，
过些天又长出来，
长到该有的长短，
就停住不长了。

我蹲下来，
跟它脸对着脸。
那几根白胡须
轻轻抖了一下——
它是在量我呢。
pages.scene: Waist-up view of the little boy crouching face to face with one cat, his face large in the frame and turned towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, wide eyed; the cat's white whiskers almost touch his cheek. No other person in the picture.
